trends.name: Iran War De-Escalation & Trump Resolution
trends.summary: Trump to address nation Wednesday 9 PM ET on Iran war with promise of quick resolution within weeks. Asian markets surging on de-escalation hopes (Nikkei +4%, Kospi leading rebound, EU stocks rebounding). Saudi Arabia intercepting drone attacks; Iran missile launches declining sharply. Market interpreting as imminent conflict end, triggering risk-on sentiment across equities.

trends.name: Oil Price Volatility & Energy Markets
trends.summary: Brent crude seesawing around $100 (as low as $98) on Trump war exit comments. UK jet fuel supply crisis—final vessel arriving in 48 hours with no resupply after. EU warning of €14B additional energy import bill. Energy ETF inflows highest since Russia-Ukraine war despite record single-stock outflows, signaling institutional rotation.

trends.name: Nike China Sales Collapse & Turnaround Failure
trends.summary: Nike shares down 9% on weak guidance with expected 20% China sales decline. Market interpreting as turnaround strategy failure. Signals deeper China consumer weakness and apparel sector headwinds affecting major multinational revenue drivers.

trends.name: Asian Market Rally on Geopolitical Relief
trends.summary: Nikkei 225 surges 4%, Kospi leads regional rebound, Asian equities and government bonds rising on hopes for quick Mideast conflict end. Japanese sentiment improving despite Iran war concerns. BoJ may face FX intervention pressure as yen weakens past 160/USD for first time since July 2024.

trends.name: Geopolitical Escalation Signals & Supply Threats
trends.summary: Iranian ballistic missiles strike Bahrain's Batelco HQ (Amazon Web Services infrastructure), first confirmed US company targeting. UAE preparing to help open Strait of Hormuz by force. Israeli military drone downed over Lebanon. Iran missile launch capacity declining (350→3 over 31 days). Critical chokepoint vulnerability emerging.

trends.name: Tech Job Cuts & Workforce Reductions
trends.summary: Oracle begins thousands of job cuts (stock rises on cost-cutting expectations). Broader pattern emerging of major tech layoffs in 2026 affecting workforce and sentiment. Market rewarding efficiency gains but signals underlying demand weakness.

trends.name: Mega IPO Wave & Capital Markets Reshaping
trends.summary: $197 billion IPO wave reshaping capital markets and crypto ecosystem. Contrasts sharply with IPO flops like Allbirds ($2.2B IPO to $39M company). Signals bifurcated market: mega-cap winners vs. retail flops, raising questions about valuation sustainability.

trends.name: Autonomous Vehicle Safety & Baidu Failures
trends.summary: Baidu robotaxis halted mid-traffic causing crashes in Wuhan, China. Safety concerns resurfacing for autonomous vehicle sector. Raises regulatory and liability questions for Chinese and global EV/autonomous leaders.

trends.name: Airline Sector Rotation & Leadership Changes
trends.summary: IndiGo (India's largest airline) jumps 9% after naming industry veteran William Walsh as CEO. Signals investor confidence in turnaround. Alaska Air downgraded on oil price and macro risk. Sector showing mixed signals on fuel costs and recovery outlook.

trends.name: Equity Flows Divergence & Buyback Deceleration
trends.summary: BofA client flow data shows selling across all sectors except SMID caps last week. Corporate buyback activity decelerating week-on-week. Energy ETF inflows highest since Russia-Ukraine war but record single-stock outflows. Institutional rotation from mega-cap to mid-cap, from individual stocks to sector ETFs.

trends.name: Solar & Renewable Energy Competitiveness Shift
trends.summary: First Solar analysis shows rising fossil fuel prices keep solar utilities competitive without tax incentive dependence. Higher oil/gas prices improving solar ROI thesis independent of policy support. Sector potentially rebalancing away from pure ESG/subsidy narrative.

trends.name: Google Hardware Expansion Into Wearables
trends.summary: Google developing proprietary fitness band to compete with screenless wearables (Whoop, Oura). Tech giant expanding ecosystem beyond software into health hardware. Signals hardware monetization strategy and potential threat to specialized wearable companies.
